Acne Studios, measured

Every value on this page is a CSS custom property generated from tokens.json, measured on the live storefront at acnestudios.com/sg/en: the near-pure monochrome palette and the one electric Acne blue, the 12px Helvetica Now Text caps that set every label, the hairline rules, the 60px rails and 360px drawers. The storefront paints a single light theme — there is no dark variant, so there is no theme toggle. The drawings below are rebuilt from the tokens; the real pixels are in screenshots/ and components/crops/.

Read from acnestudios.com on 2026-11-21, publicly, on the locale storefront the site serves headless Chromium. Helvetica Now Text and Helvetica Monospaced Pro are proprietary and not loaded here: they fall back to Helvetica/Arial and ui-monospace.

Colour

Near-pure monochrome: black text and button fills on white ground, four warm-grey steps for muted text, control borders, hairlines and field fills. One accent — Acne blue #0018a8 — carries every link, the ADD TO BAG fill and the selected states; its deeper step #051574 is hover-only; a pale blue #e8f0fe marks the picked size. Hover and focus never fade: black buttons flip to blue, blue deepens, links deepen, black labels grey.

Typography

One family, one weight, two sizes. Helvetica Now Text at 400 sets everything — chrome, buttons, headings and copy — at 12px on a 20px line with a uniform 0.3px tracking, almost always uppercased: the "Acne voice" is 12/20 caps. Field text and the sign-in title step up to 18px. Helvetica Monospaced Pro sets prices on the PDP and the size grid's numerals. There is no bold anywhere; hierarchy is size, case and colour only.

Shape, sizes and space

Every corner is square — radius 0 across the storefront. The single curve is the filter rail's 10px radio dot, drawn at border-radius:100%. Controls share one 60px height (primary buttons, the email fields); rows sit on 30px; drawers open at 360px with a 45px head; size cells are 77 x 45. Borders are always 1px hairlines; paddings are small and grid-bound.

Radius

Focus

The ring Acne draws is a 1px keyline 3px inside the control (outline-offset: -3px): white inside the black and blue buttons, deep blue on the white wishlist button, black on the size cells. Most text links draw no ring at all — focus is a colour shift only.

focusRing · 1px @ -3px
on dark fills · white

Motion

Instant: every measured control reports transition-duration: 0s — hover, focus and pressed colour flips have no easing. The only transitions the stylesheet carries are the drawers' 150ms padding-bottom slide, the accordions' 200ms max-height reveal on a cubic-bezier(0,0,0.2,1) curve, and a 500ms fade on campaign layers. Click a track to play it.

Layout

A 60px header rail (45px under 991px), then a fluid cell grid. The PLP runs four product columns; drawers are 360 wide on the right; the PDP is a two-column canvas — gallery left, a ~460px purchase column right. Hairline 1px rules separate everything.
